text:
CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE
Description
Triggered when a client-side SSL handshake is completed. If LTM
requests a certificate from the client this event would be triggered
after the
CLIENTSSL_CLIENTCERT
event.
Examples
when
CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE
{
persist
ssl
}
